title: Sync audio file information
intro: Save the review first. Only FLAC is supported for now, and covers stay the same.
waiting: Writes after playback or processing finishes.
unsupportedFormat: This format can only store library information; the audio file is not changed.
releaseHint: Choose a release to write the album and track number.
commitHint: Only the checked fields are written; the audio is not affected.

messages.busy: The audio is in use. Stop playback, preview or processing, then try again.
messages.unsupported: Tags can't be written to this audio file; the review is kept.
messages.conflict: The data or audio file changed. Open the preview again.
messages.expired: The preview expired. Create it again.
messages.verificationFailed: The write check didn't pass, so the original audio file is unchanged.
messages.insufficientSpace: Not enough space for the backup and write.
messages.limit: This is more than can be handled at once; the audio file isn't written yet.
messages.recoveryRequired: The last audio file write didn't finish. Resume it first.
messages.recoveryConflict: This can't be recovered automatically; keep the backup and check the audio file.
messages.invalidIntent: Check the selected fields and main release.
messages.cancelled: Audio file writing cancelled; the original file is unchanged.
messages.failed: The audio file can't be synced right now; saved library information is kept.
messages.synced: Audio file information synced; the original was backed up.
messages.restored: Audio file restored; library review information is kept.
messages.recovered: Audio file writing resumed. Open the preview again.
messages.stopFailed: Can't stop writing right now. Please wait.
